scope: Published E79 ESP32 TX only; source/metadata/export analysis. No RAW reread or new CRC audit.
warning_other_interface: comparisons/ebyte_e79_400dm2005s_20260724/e79_tx.csv is CH9340C, per study/generate_study.py:154-156; do not mix with this ESP32 baseline.

frozen_profile.firmware_selection: RADIO_EBYTE_E79_CC1352P + AT_COMMANDS; E79 modem firmware 0.3.0 required

modeled_duration_formula: Each physical frame: 1000 * ((physical_bytes + overhead_bytes) * 8 / rate_bps + 0.003). Transfer = sum(frame durations); this does not include measured host/UART/ACK gaps.
export_architecture: manifest accepted_result -> per-step metadata.json, summary.csv and aggregates.csv -> generate_transfer_report.build_report -> merged *_tx.csv and XLSX aggregates/summary_runs/metadata; generator does not reread RAW.
Published CSV retains rf_profile so same-rate different PHYs remain distinct.

XLSX energy_matrix_mJ groups only by power and bit_rate_kbps (generate_transfer_report.py:250-259). Its 15 matrix rows omit PHY identity and overwrite GFSK4K8 with OOK4K8 and GFSK50 with IEEE154G50; use CSV or XLSX aggregates for reanalysis comparisons.
study/generate_study.py uses the ESP32 slug for the July 19 campaign; the July 24 e79_tx.csv is explicitly mapped to CH9340C.
